title: Aastha Jain and I interview Robert Gatenby
excerpt: This is a ~1 hour interview by Aastha Jain Simes (https://www.livelongerworld.com/) and I of leading cancer researcher Robert Gatenby (https://www.moffitt.org/inspiring-stories/dr.-gatenbys-story).   Bob talks about the evolutionary and physiology approach to understanding cancer
